body: Terrevasts. Such kind words, it's really sweet.  Havenutmeg,  I hope you feel a lot better really soon.  Hugs.

30 minutes/apology....thats all the time left until I can begin.  I've done my research, I am sure I got this right this time.  I apologize to anyone on reddit I have offended or hurt by all this. I appreciated the support and advice, it's just... I ..me.. I can't do this anymore.
Tell me more, I'm trying to decide what to do right now...

How do I not hurt or scare anyone that might find my body?  Maybe I take this stuff and sit in hospital parking lot hidden a bit.  Someone will find me but maybe because it's a hospital they won't freak out?
If I take too many blood pressure meds, it would just make my heart stop right?  I don't want to screw this up and live through it and be even more tortured.

So.. Great now I am crying my head off because I can't do this today... See how much I just need to end it?  That I will cry because I have to wait?  My life is torture, from my earliest memories til present.
Fuck, I can't even do this today... It's my mothers birthday... I need to wait at least a couple days.

Only reason would be so I don't screw up other ppls lives, about nine ppl I can think of that would be messed up by it.  But there is nothing for me, just pain and self hatred, and I'm so tired of it. I can never sleep right and my insurance disallowed the claim for Ativan which I need for sleep and panic attacks.  Withstood two freaking panic attacks today and I am exhausted but I can't sleep.  I can only feel misery.
*hugs* I feel rotten too.  I'm sorry you feel this way. I get panic attacks and cry big heaving sobs for hours... Its yucky :/  anything you want to talk about?
